subject: english
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.

Though you may not be able to conquer, I exhort you to fought bravely to the last.

options.text: to fought bravely to the last

solution:
The correct answer is** "to fought bravely to the last"**.
